caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional figure, resembling the torso and legs of a human form, viewed from the back and slightly to the side. The figure appears to be wearing a cap or head covering and has an indistinct facial profile. The object includes a loosely detailed neckerchief or scarf draped around the neck, with a knot visible behind the left shoulder. The upper section shows a circular hole at the shoulder joint, suggesting a missing arm or attachment point. The torso is straight and significantly tapers at the waist, with emphasis on the contours of the back muscles and clothing folds. The figure is dressed in pants with straight legs, which are truncated at the bottom, revealing two downward-protruding rods or pegs. The entire composition is executed in grayscale pencil or graphite, with shading used to create volume and texture. The background is plain and unshaded, enclosed within a rectangular border. A small horizontal scale marked in inches is located in the lower left corner, and the signature “Bernard Westmacott” appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Whirligig
